scope: Init-only nominal 32768 Hz LSE SYSCLK on exactly three CW32L010 packages, using Config.lse and the unchanged native low-power oscillator admission. Generic L010, L011 and L012 are excluded. Source qualification only; no hardware validation.
hardware_count_source: Own RM PDF59/68: fewer than 128 LSE edges in 256 LSI cycles detects running failure when LSECCS is enabled.
margin_source: Software policy adds one edge: minimum_LSE_hz * 256 > 129 * 36080, using the board individual-cycle lower bound. It is not a hardware threshold or a measured LSI guarantee.

native_lsi_reference.basis: RM PDF56 permits 32.8 kHz +/-10%; DS PDF43 factory +/-3% is a separate condition and is not substituted for inherited legal trim.

fallback.basis: RM PDF59/68 documents effective HSI4MHz fallback for detected selected-LSE failure with CLKCCS=1. The existing /12 numerical model and DS PDF43 factory HSI +/-2% give 3.92-4.08MHz after factory trim is established. No HSI.DIV, HSIEN, CR0 or bus-divider post-fault mutation is specified. Qualify full 4.08MHz on both buses without divider credit, even with CLKCCS=0; independently validate requested HSI at final divisors.

transition_policy: Retain the existing factory-HSI calibration bridge with target-only, latched entry-nonstable LSI first-request admission. Keep LSI TRIM/WAIT unchanged. Raise and verify Flash WAIT1 before source transitions. After the owned WAIT change, prove original non-WAIT CR2, IER, LSE and LSI TRIM/WAIT identity before fresh native admission. Install and verify final divisors under calibrated HSI before the last LSE mux write; perform no subsequent CR0 write. Final Flash planning covers declared LSE HCLK, requested factory HSI HCLK and full 4.08MHz fallback. Publish only after final source, policy, mux/divider and post-pad-window checks.
cold_lsi_admission: When the inherited backend will request LSI for needs_trim or needs_lsi and entry LSI was not stable, reject RTC SOURCE2, UART1/2 SOURCE3, enabled LPTIM ICLKSRC3, MCO SOURCE4, LSIRDY enable and enabled analog LSI requesters. Restore exact configuration gates; held reset and gate restoration errors remain visible. These checks do not prove uninspected timer, GPIO, IWDT or external roots idle; the caller must permit or disconnect their progress.
hsi_ownership: RTC SOURCE3 requires already enabled, stable, factory-matching HSI. A target HSI start/restart also rejects MCO SOURCE3 and enabled HSIRDY; live factory-matching DIV-only changes preserve raw HSIOSC.
auxiliary_projection: Remove only sysclk_detector, then retain the existing native_low_power to native_l010 historical projection. All prior auxiliary facts and proof hashes remain unchanged.
limits: StartupOnly loss can stop the CPU with STABLE still set and no failure flag. Poll budgets are CPU iterations only while execution continues.
Preserved fault routes can affect IRQs, timer capture/brake and external observers before return.
No frozen-clock validity, RTC continuity, recovery or bounded loss-to-fallback guarantee after source loss.
No LSI trim write, borrowed-flag clearing, RTC migration, runtime switching, wake/resume or silicon validation.

members.binding: Member identity is anchored to the locked archive; startup loads HSI and LSI factory trim, which the Rust initializer does not call.

sdk_corroboration.authority_limit: Selector and startup corroboration only. SDK LSE analog fields and broad helper writes do not override reserved own RM fields or native admission.
